models.name: tk-stock-hatch-muscle
models.note: Toy kit construction, front wheels in the open. Hot hatch in the pony's dress: stripes over bonnet and roof, quad lamps, chrome bumpers; the roof vent gives way to the stripes.

models.name: tk-jeep-b
models.note: Toy kit construction, front wheels in the open. Hardtop 4x4: a roofed cab with windows all round, roof rails with lamps, a bull bar, the spare on the tail.

models.name: tk-muscle-c
models.note: Toy kit construction, front wheels in the open. Pony fastback: a long hood under twin white stripes, a fastback roof with rear louvres, quad lamps, chrome bumpers.
